integrity: The argument is an elementary projective-plane back-and-forth proof. Exact finite signatures and the optimized atomic-extension enumerator are replayable from the included C++17 file. This is a self-review and not independent validation.
limitations: Rank at most five only; finite nondegenerate projective planes with named point and line sorts and incidence. No claim for higher ranks, uncoloured Levi graphs or nonprojective incidence designs. Numerical checks use Desarguesian orders 2,3,4,5 only. Literature survey cannot exclude unindexed coverage.
title: Three rank-five theories of finite projective planes
